stories.title: Finn and the Air-Bubble Elevator
stories.outro: See you next time in Sunny Meadow!

youtube.title: Finn and the Air-Bubble Elevator | Sunny Meadow
youtube.description: Finn missed his third pretend elevator in a row. Wally watched another little bubble rise above the rock. A playful adventure with a funny ending. #SunnyMeadow #DreamyDiscoveries

lines.text: Finn missed his third pretend elevator in a row.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Wally watched another little bubble rise above the rock.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Wait! I have not finished announcing my floor!
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Your elevator has a very impatient timetable.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Finn wanted to play at riding an ocean elevator.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: He had chosen the bubble stream beside a small rock.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: First floor, seaweed. Second floor, the bright water!
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Then I shall be your very grand elevator announcer.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Finn pressed an imaginary button beside the rock.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: The next bubble rose without slowing down at all.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Going up, please! I have pressed the correct button!
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Perhaps that button is attached to an imaginary elevator.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Finn tried giving the next bubble a ticket.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: He held a loose bit of seaweed in one fin.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: One journey to the bright water, please.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Your passenger ticket seems larger than the elevator.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Do bubbles wait for a pretend elevator button?
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: The bubble passed the little ticket and kept rising.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Finn circled back to his rock with a sigh.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: It has gone without inspecting my excellent ticket.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: This service has a remarkably quick ticket check.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Finn tried waiting a little higher in the water.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Another bubble slipped past before he began his announcement.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Now I have missed the second floor instead!
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Perhaps your elevator is designed for bubble passengers only.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Finn watched three small bubbles rising close together.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: He realized he could swim beside their little path.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: I do not have to sit inside the bubble.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: You could escort it to its imaginary destinations.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Finn asked Wally to announce the first departure.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Wally gave a gentle, grand elevator voice.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Please stand back. One bubble service is now leaving!
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: I am swimming alongside with my ticket ready.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Finn swam beside a bubble as it rose.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: He kept his own fins moving at its gentle pace.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Wally announced the seaweed floor in a grand whisper.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Finn paused beside the leaves while the bubble continued.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: How can Finn travel alongside a bubble?
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Finn joined the next bubble for the second pretend floor.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: The water grew brighter above the little rock.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Second floor, coming up! All fins moving comfortably!
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Your elevator passenger appears to be doing the swimming.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Finn stopped at his chosen bright patch of water.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: A tiny bubble continued beyond their pretend floor.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Arrival complete. This elevator ride has excellent exercise.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Our machinery is powered by one enthusiastic little fish.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: They swam back beside the rock to swap their roles.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Finn took the announcer's place near the seaweed leaves.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Next passenger, please. One very grand whale coming through!
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: I may need more than one bubble for my journey.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Wally floated upward beside a string of tiny bubbles.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Finn announced every imaginary floor with great ceremony.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Mind the doors! Actually, there are no doors.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Then I shall mind my very enormous tail instead.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: The last bubble vanished into the brighter water above.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Finn gave the quiet elevator rock a polite nod.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Service closed. The elevators have gone home for lunch.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Perhaps tomorrow they can wait until we finish speaking.
lines.speaker: friend
